h2: NDT training near Norfolk: shipyard apprenticeships, waterfront trainee jobs, out-of-state colleges and online study compared
html:
NDT training near Norfolk: shipyard apprenticeships, waterfront trainee jobs, out-of-state colleges and online study compared

In Hampton Roads, NDT training is shaped by the shipyards. A near-me search from Norfolk, Portsmouth or Chesapeake will not turn up a local NDT certificate or degree; we did not find one in the public college catalogues we checked. What exists instead is an apprenticeship at the big private yard across the water, trainee jobs at ship repair yards on the Elizabeth River, federal inspector vacancies for people who already hold certifications, and online theory with the practical done at an employer. Here is what each one asks of you.

Who offers NDT training around Norfolk?

  • The Apprentice School at Newport News Shipbuilding. Its Non-Destructive Tester trade teaches radiographic, magnetic particle, liquid penetrant, ultrasonic and eddy current inspection, along with visual inspection, quality standards and code interpretation. Apprentices calibrate equipment, run the tests, evaluate results and write inspection reports. You have to be accepted as an apprentice by the shipyard; it is not a course you can join from outside.
  • Ship repair yards in Norfolk. Colonna's Shipyard, in the Berkley section, has advertised a QA-NDT Inspector Trainee role: supervised on-the-job training in VT, MT, PT and UT, working toward certification. Applicants needed introductory classroom and lab training in at least one method aligned with SNT-TC-1A, ASNT or AWS guidelines, or had to be willing to complete it, plus US citizenship, eligibility for base access and a willingness to learn NAVSEA Standard Items.
  • Norfolk Naval Shipyard, Portsmouth. The shipyard's apprentice programme trains boilermakers, pipefitters, shipfitters and other trades, but NDT is not one of its listed trades. Its NDT inspector vacancies, posted on USAJOBS in the 3705 series, have asked applicants to hold PT and MT certification already, plus one of UT thickness, RT Level I or ET acquisition. Certification comes before the federal job, not after it.
  • Out-of-state college programmes. The nearest full NDT degree we verified is at Central Piedmont Community College in Charlotte, North Carolina: a two-year associate degree in hybrid format covering ultrasonics, radiography, eddy current, magnetic particle, penetrant and visual testing. Community colleges in Hampton Roads offer welding programmes, a common way into shipyard inspection.

Which route fits you?

Your situationRealistic route in Hampton RoadsWhat to check
School leaver or career changer who wants paid trainingAn application to the Apprentice School, or a trainee role at a repair yardAcceptance, citizenship and base-access rules
Applicant who needs classroom hours to qualify for a trainee jobOnline method theory in VT, MT, PT or UT, with the hours documentedThat the record states method, topics and hours
Technician adding a method or a levelOnline theory and a practical under your employer's written practiceNavy contracts can add requirements beyond SNT-TC-1A
Repair contractor certifying a crewTraining delivered at your own yard or shop with Level III examinationsA current written practice that your Navy customers will accept

Questions to ask any NDT training provider near Norfolk

  • Will a yard accept the record? Trainee postings here ask for introductory training aligned with SNT-TC-1A. Ask whether the course record lists method, level, topics and hours, and check the targets with the SNT-TC-1A hours planner.
  • Ship-like specimens. Does the practical use plate and pipe welds similar to ship structure, or only reference blocks?
  • Navy requirements. Does the course cover only SNT-TC-1A, or does it claim more? Navy work can bring its own qualification rules through the contract, and those are met at the employer.
  • Who certifies you. Your employer does, under its written practice, or ASNT after its central exams; a course gives you a training record.
  • Level III access. Can you ask a Level III technical questions while you study?

Where Atlantis fits for Norfolk candidates and employers

Atlantis NDT has no classroom anywhere in Hampton Roads. Method theory is online and self-paced, it opens the day you enrol, and an ASNT NDT Level III answers questions as you go. Because the Atlantis course is built on SNT-TC-1A and its record lists method, level and hours, it gives a repair-yard applicant something concrete to show; whether a yard accepts it is the employer's call. You practise in the UT simulator and other Practical NDT workplaces, and the hands-on practical and examination take place at your employer, on its equipment, under its written practice. The methods waterfront postings name are visual testing, magnetic particle testing, penetrant testing and ultrasonic testing; begin with NDT Level 1 training.

Ship repair contractors can have training delivered at their own yard or shop and a Level III build the programme: see SNT-TC-1A training programme set-up. Weld inspectors aiming at CWI can look at AWS CWI exam preparation for Norfolk. Nearby pages: NDT training in Newport News, NDT training in Richmond and the Virginia training page.
